title: MonacoCodeEditor
description: A labelled Monaco editor running on a local engine (never a CDN) that follows the page theme. If the engine cannot load or mount in time, it degrades to an editable textarea with a retry button. Import it from minerva-design/monaco; @monaco-editor/react and monaco-editor are optional peer dependencies. The Web Component <minerva-code-editor> is published as the optional entry minerva-design/web-components/code-editor (outside the all-in-one entry and the CDN bundle), with monaco-editor as its optional peer dependency.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, shallowRef } from "vue";
import { MonacoCodeEditor } from "minerva-design/vue/monaco";
import { Alert, Button, Stack } from "minerva-design/vue";

const code = ref("Text stays editable while the engine is unavailable.");
const engine = shallowRef<typeof import("monaco-editor")>();
const loading = ref(false);
const loadError = ref("");
async function recover() {
  loading.value = true;
  loadError.value = "";
  try {
    engine.value = (await import("../engine")).monaco;
  } catch (error) {
    loadError.value =
      error instanceof Error
        ? error.message
        : "The local editor engine could not be loaded. Retry when it is available.";
  } finally {
    loading.value = false;
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Stack :gap="3" style="width: 100%">
    <MonacoCodeEditor
      v-model="code"
      :monaco="engine"
      label="Recoverable editor"
      :load-timeout="1"
      :height="220"
    />
    <Button :loading="loading" @click="recover"
      >Load local editor engine</Button
    >
    <Alert v-if="loadError" color="danger" title="Editor engine unavailable">{{
      loadError
    }}</Alert>
    <output>{{ code }}</output>
  </Stack>
</template>

basic.title: Local engine, theme and form
basic.description: Load the optional entry minerva-design/web-components/code-editor and the application's own Monaco engine, then set it as the monaco property. The editor follows the page / <minerva-config> theme, fires minerva-input on each edit (React's onChange) and submits its value with the form.

fallback.title: Loading, fallback and late engine
fallback.description: Without an engine the editor shows its loading state, then after load-timeout an editable textarea with a Retry button (minerva-error fires). Providing the engine later loads the editor with the latest value.

props.name: Name under which the value is submitted with the form.
props.required: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).
props.defaultValue: Initial source text (the value attribute), restored by form.reset(). Changing it also changes value until the user edits the code.
props.resolvedTheme: Theme actually applied: theme, else the closest data-theme (a <minerva-config> scope, then <html>) (read-only).
props.monaco: Local Monaco engine (import * as monaco from "monaco-editor"), set as a property; one per application. Never loaded from a CDN.
props.value: Source text (property; the value attribute sets defaultValue). Updated on each edit; setting it applies the text as an undoable edit.
props.theme: Color theme (light or dark); defaults to the theme of the element's scope (closest data-theme: a <minerva-config>, then <html>), followed live.
props.disabled: Makes the editor (and its fallback) read-only; not submitted, not validated.
props.loadTimeout: Milliseconds to wait for the engine and the editor before showing the textarea fallback (also when no engine is set yet).

events.change: The value was committed: the editor lost focus after an edit.
events.minerva-input: Same as input, with detail: { value } (React's onChange).
events.minerva-change: Same as change, with detail: { value }.
events.minerva-error: The editor became unavailable (no engine in time, invalid engine, or it threw) and the textarea fallback is shown.

slots.editor: Created by the element: the light DOM <div> Monaco renders into, so the stylesheets Monaco adds to the document apply. Do not fill it yourself.

methods.focus: Focuses the editor (or its fallback textarea).
methods.retry: Tries to load the editor again (what the Retry button does).
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
